whoami.title: About me
whoami.positioning: Indie game developer. I also build the tools.
whoami.lede: I make Godot games about time and echoes, and I build websites, tools and servers that actually run.
paragraphs: Over the past year I entered 13 game jams and contests and won 4 awards. Time is the theme I keep returning to: delays, rewinds, echoes, and solving puzzles with your past self.

Outside games I build websites and tools. GeoScore is an open-source SEO / GEO audit service, and Search Gateway is a self-hosted search gateway. I deploy and maintain all of sayori.org and the 31 services behind it myself.
I like to get a working version first, then improve it through play and use. AI speeds up implementation; debugging, trade-offs and game feel are my calls.
whoami.availability: Open for small commissions: game prototypes, interactive web pages and web tools. One project at a time, finished properly.

works.title: Works
works.intro: Six games and four tools. Every one can be played, used or read as source.

wake-up-at-the-border.type: 2D pixel side-scroller · puzzles, dialogue and combat
wake-up-at-the-border.role: Lead programmer for gameplay and systems
wake-up-at-the-border.summary: Second prize in the themed jam track of Godot Hub Festival 2025.
highlights: A finite state machine drives player and enemy movement, attacks, blocking and hit reactions, plus dash, double jump and air attacks
Branching, localized dialogue built on Dialogue Manager, tied to a multi-quest tracker with rewards
Collision layers for world, player, enemies, attacks and NPCs, with one path for scene changes and loading

time-rewind-linker.summary: Record a route, rewind, and a beam links your past self to your present self. Doors open only when that beam sweeps across a sensor. Best Time-Themed Game at the 034 Challenge Game Jam #2.
highlights: A ring buffer records and rewinds 5 seconds at 30 fps by default, with optional position, velocity and animation fields
A TimeController owns time scale and audio pitch together, and lets selected nodes stay immune or frozen
Tunable jumps — rise height, rise time and fall curve — with coyote time and input buffering

beyond-the-heart.role: Team project; I wrote all of the code
beyond-the-heart.summary: As a “mind detective”, you build bridges through a patient's inner world. Excellent Game Award at the Kaying Cup (卡赢杯) Open-Source Game Contest, Hangzhou Dianzi University round.
highlights: The core bridge-building mechanic and level interactions
Coyote jumps and buffered jump input for forgiving, responsive controls

retrace.summary: Wake ancient mechanisms with resonance in blue-green ruins, and leave an echo that travels with your self from a moment ago. Entered in thatgamejam #02 and Improve My Game Jam 47; about half an hour long.
highlights: Resonance and echo replay: special devices replay your last 8 seconds of movement
Mechanisms are composable components, so new levels need no change to the main flow
Menus, hints and journal pages in 8 languages; Windows and web builds

delaytrace.summary: The route you take becomes your “past self” 1, 3 or 5 seconds later and chases you. You can also record a route and send it back as a “future echo”. Winner of a third prize at GodotHub Festival 2026.
highlights: Present, past and future timelines solve puzzles together in the same room
Playable in the browser, with touch controls in the Android build
Dialogue in English and Simplified Chinese

mios-window-wanderer.role: Team of four; I handled programming
mios-window-wanderer.summary: A thatgamejam #01 entry. Mio wakes up in a virtual world her sister built and pieces together the truth by moving between real desktop windows.
highlights: Scenes and dialogue live in several real OS windows, as an experiment in window-based navigation
A dialogue-driven story in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Japanese

geoscore.summary: Scores only what it can observe on the page, says which checks could not be verified, and points to the failures worth fixing first.
highlights: Runs on Cloudflare Workers, Pages, D1, KV, Vectorize and Workers AI
Site mode samples up to five pages deterministically by page type; an interrupted audit reuses module results that are still valid
37 stars on GitHub; live at geo.sayori.org

enhanced-save-system.summary: A modular save framework with a global save plus slots, where save modules register and run by priority.
highlights: Atomic writes (.tmp, then rename) with optional .bak backups, so an interrupted write never corrupts a save
Optional AES-GCM / AES-CBC encryption and gzip / deflate compression, with registered migrations between versions
A runtime save manager and an editor bottom panel

search-gateway.summary: One API for AI tools: web search, page extraction, screenshots, research summaries and MCP access.
highlights: Built with FastAPI; providers are configured per deployment and the repository holds no runtime credentials
Multi-source evidence snapshots make it easy to check what an AI answer actually cited
Open source under the MIT license

agent-session-bridge.summary: Copies or moves conversation context between ten AI coding clients, including Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and Qwen Code.
highlights: Everything runs locally: no model calls and no uploads
Moves only the conversation and compaction summaries, filtering out tool calls and reasoning
A Python CLI plus an AI skill, MIT-licensed, 9 stars on GitHub
